description: Registered suppressions and narrowly scoped type bridges. Every live suppression must match an entry; bridge entries name their owning declaration and retirement trigger.

exceptions.reason: TanStack Router generates this file with both directives to opt generated route metadata out of authored-code lint and type analysis.
nativeAlternativesExamined: The root lint ignore excludes the generated file, but cannot remove the generator-emitted directives.
No source-level alternative exists without changing the route generator's output.
exceptions.retirementTrigger: Retire when TanStack Router stops emitting these directives or the generated route tree is no longer part of the workspace source.

exceptions.reason: The rule mistakes the native Schema.TaggedError class declaration for a throw site; the command needs a typed documentation failure.
exceptions.missingCapability: The installed rule cannot distinguish this Effect error declaration from a throw statement.
nativeAlternativesExamined: Schema.TaggedError is the native typed error; the check is disabled only around its declaration, not its uses.
Throwing a native error or using an untyped failure would lose the command's typed error channel.
exceptions.retirementTrigger: Remove this exception when the rule accepts Schema.TaggedError declarations, then run the documentation checks.

exceptions.reason: Playwright owns the browser test callbacks and expects promises; its test functions and helpers await browser operations directly.
exceptions.missingCapability: The Effect async-function diagnostic cannot recognize a Playwright-owned Promise boundary.
nativeAlternativesExamined: Effect.promise can wrap a foreign Promise, but requires a Promise-returning thunk; the configured promise-function-async rule conflicts with effecttsgo/async-function at that boundary.
An Effect runtime inside each individual browser callback would not remove the framework's Promise ABI or the conflicting rules.
exceptions.retirementTrigger: Remove the exception when the diagnostics accept Playwright's Promise callbacks without contradicting promise-function-async, then run the browser journey.

typeBridges.reason: Replace emitted schema identifiers without changing string literals or comments.
typeBridges.missingCapability: Effect does not provide a TypeScript syntax parser.
nativeAlternativesExamined: The Effect Schema modules model data schemas, not TypeScript source syntax.
Text replacement cannot distinguish code from string literals.
verification: devenv shell -- bunx vp -C packages/cms-client test test/finiteNumbers.test.ts
typeBridges.retirementTrigger: Retire when the upstream generator emits finite schemas directly or Effect provides a suitable TypeScript parser.
